cues.text: Cover, frame one, no host: our own drawn kitchen at night (EXAMPLE): the furnace closet, a thermostat reading COLD, frost on the window, a phone glowing on the counter. Plate "Who does ChatGPT" / "send her to?". On "quits" the furnace light goes out.

The phone close: our own drawn chat box (EXAMPLE, never a real ChatGPT screen and no reply shown); the question types in: "Who should I hire to fix my furnace near me?" A send arrow; three dots pulse. No answer is drawn.

Scene two: our own forum card (paraphrase, no names): "Owner forum (Jobber)"; the line types in: "At least 4 people last month told me ChatGPT is how they found us." A counter 1 to 4 on "four". Tag "Jobber Community, Nov 2026, paraphrased".
The same card; a second line: "Didn't think I'd done a thing there." A "?" bobs over a blank ChatGPT row.
The kitchen phone again, then a shop phone on a truck dash: it stays dark, a call bar that never fills; on "never" the counter reads CALLS: 0 and a NO RING stamp lands.

THE CHECK (the send moment, held to screenshot): a save-screen card, both steps land in the first half second and then nothing moves over it (held to screenshot): '1. Ask ChatGPT: "Who's the best [your trade] near me?"' and "2. Not you? Fix your Google profile first."
The column card: WHAT IT READS, three rows tick in on their words: YOUR NAME, YOUR WEBSITE, YOUR REVIEWS. Tag "ACHR News guest column, Mar 18, 2026 (SearchLight data)".
A revenue bar: a sliver lights, ABOUT 1%; on "big" the ticket slams: $11,500 A TICKET (the firm's average). Same column tag.
The kitchen phone, the question still on it; THE CHECK card slides back in small; plate "Ask it" / "before they do."; Snow points at step 1. Then the end card with the send line.
